response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT at.account_id, d.A3 AS region, at.total_amount, at.transaction_count, 1.0 * at.total_amount / SUM(at.total_amount) OVER () AS fraction_of_all_transactions FROM account_totals AS at JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = at.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY fraction_of_all_transactions DESC, at.account_id LIMIT 10
